exposure: Surplus fat accumulation in liver and pancreas
cohort: The abstract discusses findings related to people with type 2 diabetes, particularly focusing on those in the early stages post-diagnosis.
finding: Substantial weight loss can reverse type 2 diabetes by reducing surplus fat from the liver and pancreas, which normalizes hepatic insulin responsiveness and facilitates beta cell recovery.
followup_time: 12 months (referenced for the Diabetes Remission Clinical Trial)
